detail: Added al-diff, align and notes-card from the command line, then clicked the notes-card tile. The body links #al-diff and bare al-diff (2 links in total). #ghost-card and bare align stay plain text. The code span 'node src/cli.ts show #al-diff' is a <code> element with no link inside.
pr-iface has a why line that holds #al-diff. A click on that link opens the card view of al-diff, and the page shows 'Diff the alignment'.

In the doc-card body: the heading shows 'al-diff' with no link. The URL paragraph has no a[href=#al-diff]. The fenced pre shows #al-diff with no link. The code span `#al-diff` renders as a link to #al-diff.
The map tile for ref-card (title 'Follows up on #al-diff' is the summary) has no nested link. A click on the tile opens ref-card. The notes region shows 'al-diff' as a link.

The json fence renders as one pre with a solid border and tok-* highlight spans. Its textContent equals the source lines with 4/8-space indentation. white-space is pre. scrollWidth > clientWidth, and scrollLeft moves sideways. The body is no wider than the card article, and the page has no horizontal overflow.

The fixture board shows the columns in the order blocked, ready, building, merging, done. Tickets 4/3/2/5/1 are each one card in the expected column. Ticket 5 (building then merging) shows only in merging.
Ticket 2 (2 retries) shows its title and a retry badge with 2. Ticket 3 (1 retry) shows its title and no retry badge. Neither card text holds the brief, the cited ids or the checks.
I appended board events: ticket 7 (ready, no blockers) and ticket 6, blocked by 1 (done) and 7 (ready). Ticket 6 shows a blocker badge with 1. Ticket 7 shows no blocker badge.

I appended ticket 8 with a long brief, cites map and log, a blocker on ticket 2, and two retries. A click on it opens the drawer. The left slice holds the full brief text. The right metadata shows #map and #log, the blocker 'Draw the map in a browser', retries 2, and the checks. The slice is left of the metadata, the drawer is below .board, and all five columns stay visible.

In the drawer of ticket 3, a click on #map-hash switches the nav to Map. The card view shows map-hash with its title and body. A click on Board shows the same five columns with the same ticket numbers as before.
